meta.name: Generate recipe PDFs from food photos with OpenRouter, Apify and Google Drive

parameters.content:
## Receive and analyze image

Captures the form submission and sends the submitted image or food-related input to OpenRouter for initial visual analysis.

## Create recipe HTML

Uses the AI Agent, OpenRouter chat model, and structured parser to transform the image analysis into well-formed recipe HTML for PDF generation.

## Generate PDF with Apify

Runs the Apify actor, checks the latest run, and retrieves the generated PDF or related output from the actor key-value store.

## Upload PDF file

Uploads the generated recipe PDF to Google Drive as the final output of the workflow.

parameters.content:
## Food Recipes PDF Generator

### How it works

This workflow starts when a user submits a form, likely including food or recipe-related input. It analyzes the submitted image with OpenRouter, uses an AI agent to create structured HTML for a recipe document, then sends that HTML through Apify to generate a PDF. After the Apify run completes, it retrieves the generated file from the key-value store and uploads it to Google Drive.

### Setup steps

- Configure the form trigger with the required fields, such as image upload and any recipe preferences or metadata.
- Add OpenRouter credentials/API keys for both the HTTP image analysis request and the OpenRouter Chat Model used by the AI Agent.
- Configure the AI Agent prompt and Structured Output Parser schema so the generated HTML matches the expected Apify actor input.
- Set up Apify credentials and verify the selected actor can render the provided HTML into a PDF and store the output in a key-value store.
- Connect Google Drive credentials and choose the destination folder for uploaded PDF files.

### Customization

You can customize the form fields, OpenRouter model, AI prompt, HTML template, Apify actor settings, and Google Drive destination folder to change the recipe style, PDF layout, or storage location.

The Thanksgiving Collection

A curated selection of seasonal favorites

Glazed Turkey Breast

Ingredients

  • 1.5-2 lb turkey breast (boneless)
  • 1 tbsp olive oil, Salt & Pepper
  • Glaze: 2 tbsp butter, 1/4 cup shallots, 2 garlic cloves, 1/2 cup cranberry sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp ACV, 1 tsp Dijon, thyme.

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 375°F. Season turkey with oil, salt, and pepper.
  2. Sear in an oven-safe skillet for 4 mins per side until golden.
  3. Roast for 30-45 mins (target 160°F).
  4. Simmer glaze ingredients in a pan for 5-7 mins until thickened.
  5. Brush turkey with glaze; roast 5-10 mins more until 165°F. Rest for 10 mins before slicing.

Creamy Mashed Potatoes

Ingredients

  • 2 lbs Yukon Gold or Russet potatoes
  • 1/2 cup whole milk
  • 1/4 cup softened butter
  • 2-4 tbsp sour cream (optional)
  • Salt, pepper, & fresh chives

Instructions

  1. Boil peeled potato chunks in salted water for 15-20 mins until tender.
  2. Drain and return to hot pot for 1 min to dry.
  3. Mash until smooth; stir in warm milk, butter, and sour cream.
  4. Season to taste and garnish with chives.

Crispy Roasted Potatoes

Ingredients

  • 2 lbs small red potatoes, cubed
  • 3 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1/2 tsp garlic & onion powder
  • Salt, pepper, parsley

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F.
  2. Toss potatoes with oil and all spices until coated.
  3. Spread on a baking sheet (do not overcrowd).
  4. Roast 30-40 mins, flipping halfway, until golden and crispy.

Cranberry Sauce

Ingredients

  • 12 oz fresh/frozen cranberries
  • 3/4 cup sugar
  • 1/2 cup water or orange juice
  • Pinch of cinnamon & cloves
  • Orange zest

Instructions

  1. Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan.
  2. Bring to a boil, then simmer over medium-low heat.
  3. Cook for 10-15 mins until berries burst and sauce thickens.
  4. Cool completely before serving (it will thicken further).
Enjoy your holiday meal! • Prepared for your kitchen • Autumn 2024

message.content:
This looks like a delicious Thanksgiving-inspired meal! Here are recipes for what appears to be on the plate: Glazed Turkey Breast, Creamy Mashed Potatoes, Crispy Roasted Potatoes, and Cranberry Sauce.

### **Glazed Turkey Breast**

This recipe assumes you're starting with a boneless, skinless turkey breast.

**Ingredients:**

*   1.5-2 lb boneless, skinless turkey breast
*   1 tbsp olive oil
*   Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

**For the Glaze:**

*   2 tbsp unsalted butter
*   1/4 cup finely chopped shallots (or red onion)
*   2 cloves garlic, minced
*   1/2 cup cranberry sauce (store-bought or homemade, see recipe below)
*   2 tbsp brown sugar (or maple syrup)
*   1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
*   1 tsp Dijon mustard
*   1/2 tsp dried thyme
*   Pinch of red pepper flakes (optional, for a little kick)
*   Fresh chives, chopped, for garnish

**Instructions:**

1.  **Prepare the Turkey:** Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Pat the turkey breast dry with paper towels. Rub with olive oil, then season generously with salt and pepper.
2.  **Sear (Optional, but recommended for color):** Heat an oven-safe skillet (like cast iron) over medium-high heat. Sear the turkey breast for 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown.
3.  **Roast:** Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven. Roast for 30-45 minutes, or until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the breast registers 160°F (71°C). The temperature will rise a bit as it rests.
4.  **Make the Glaze:** While the turkey roasts, melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add shallots and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes. Add minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
5.  Stir in cranberry sauce, brown sugar, apple cider vinegar, Dijon mustard, dried thyme, and red pepper flakes (if using). Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low and cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the glaze thickens slightly. Taste and adjust seasonings as needed.
6.  **Glaze and Finish:** Once the turkey reaches 160°F, remove it from the oven. Brush a generous amount of the glaze over the top and sides of the turkey breast. Return to the oven for another 5-10 minutes, or until the glaze is bubbling and slightly caramelized, and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
7.  **Rest and Serve:** Remove turkey from the oven, transfer to a cutting board, and tent loosely with foil. Let rest for at least 10 minutes before slicing. This helps the juices redistribute, keeping the turkey moist.
8.  Slice the turkey and arrange on a plate. Drizzle with any remaining glaze and garnish with fresh chopped chives.

---

### **Creamy Mashed Potatoes**

**Ingredients:**

*   2 lbs russet or Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks
*   1/2 cup whole milk (or half-and-half)
*   1/4 cup unsalted butter, softened
*   2-4 tbsp sour cream or cream cheese (optional, for extra creaminess)
*   Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
*   Fresh chives, chopped, for garnish

**Instructions:**

1.  **Boil Potatoes:** Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with cold, salted water by about an inch. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until very tender when pierced with a fork, about 15-20 minutes.
2.  **Drain and Mash:** Drain the potatoes well in a colander. Return them to the hot pot over low heat for a minute or two to evaporate any remaining moisture.
3.  Mash the potatoes using a potato masher or a potato ricer until smooth.
4.  **Combine Ingredients:** Gradually add the warm milk, butter, and sour cream (if using), mixing until smooth and creamy. Start with less liquid and add more until desired consistency is reached.
5.  Season generously with salt and pepper. Taste and adjust as needed.
6.  Serve hot, garnished with fresh chives.

---

### **Crispy Roasted Potatoes**

**Ingredients:**

*   1.5-2 lbs small red or Yukon Gold potatoes, cut into 1-inch chunks
*   2-3 tbsp olive oil
*   1 tsp smoked paprika
*   1/2 tsp garlic powder
*   1/2 tsp onion powder
*   1/4 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, for a little heat)
*   Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
*   Fresh parsley or chives, chopped, for garnish

**Instructions:**

1.  **Preheat Oven:** Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
2.  **Prepare Potatoes:** In a large bowl, toss the potato chunks with olive oil until evenly coated.
3.  **Season:** Add smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and black pepper. Toss again until the potatoes are well coated with the seasonings.
4.  **Roast:** Spread the seasoned potatoes in a single layer on a large baking sheet (do not overcrowd, use two sheets if necessary for crispier results).
5.  Roast for 30-40 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the potatoes are tender on the inside and crispy and golden brown on the outside.
6.  Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or chives.

---

### **Homemade Cranberry Sauce**

**Ingredients:**

*   12 oz (about 3 cups) fresh or frozen cranberries
*   3/4 cup granulated sugar (adjust to taste)
*   1/2 cup water (or orange juice for extra flavor)
*   1/4 tsp ground cinnamon (optional)
*   Pinch of ground cloves (optional)
*   Orange zest from half an orange (optional)

**Instructions:**

1.  **Combine Ingredients:** In a medium saucepan, combine cranberries, sugar, and water (or orange juice). If using, add cinnamon, cloves, and orange zest.
2.  **Simmer:** Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally.
3.  **Cook:** Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until most of the cranberries have burst and the sauce has thickened. Stir occasionally.
4.  **Cool:** Remove from heat. The sauce will continue to thicken as it cools.
5.  **Serve:** Serve warm or chilled. Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to a week.

Enjoy your meal!
